SIG AF (Special Interest Group for Atrieflimren) is a professional medical group in Denmark dedicated to improving the care, education, and data registration for patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The organization serves as a key partner in the national healthcare quality infrastructure, working in close collaboration with the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] [^src1]. 

The group's primary significance lies in its responsibility for the development, dissemination, and implementation of clinical guidelines for patient education [^src1]. National quality reports have revealed systemic barriers in this area, such as a lack of harmonized educational offerings across regional health clusters and the failure to correctly apply the specific administrative code "BFKB" for structured patient education [^src1]. To address these shortcomings and ensure that newly diagnosed patients receive proper instruction within their first year, SIG AF is tasked with rolling out standardized educational guidelines nationwide [^src1]. 

Chronologically, the foundation for these current efforts was laid in 2023, when guidelines for the content of patient education were developed based on the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) guidelines [^src1]. Moving into the coming year, SIG AF has announced an increased focus on two main objectives: disseminating the recommended educational content to patients across the country and ensuring the correct coding of this education to accurately track national quality metrics [^src1].
